claims.text: Equimolar or near-equimolar multimetallic nanoparticles can initially crystallize as a single-phase solid solution.
Slower cooling or mild pre-annealing can induce a controlled degree of short-range ordering in these nanoparticles.
Rapid quenching produces a near-ideal random solid solution with minimal short-range ordering.
A globally random or solid-solution multielement nanoparticle can nevertheless possess local short-range chemical ordering.
Short-range order is associated with local compositional fluctuations and element-specific nearest-neighbor affinities.
Controlled short-range order alleviates internal lattice strain.
Controlled short-range order hinders atomic diffusion by raising diffusion barriers.
Higher diffusion barriers caused by short-range order reduce elevated-temperature phase separation and chemical segregation.
Short-range-ordered nanoparticles will maintain structural integrity and chemical uniformity better than rapidly quenched nanoparticles from 473 to 1923 K.
After prolonged thermal cycling, controlled-SRO nanoparticles will exhibit less elemental segregation than the rapid-quench control.
Rapid-quench nanoparticles are more prone to diffusion-driven phase degradation.
FT-EXAFS, HAADF-STEM, and nearest-neighbor compositional analysis can detect short-range ordering or departures from a random elemental distribution.
The controlled comparison holds overall composition and operating conditions constant while changing the synthesis treatment used to control SRO.
The magnitude of any stability improvement may depend on elemental composition and synthesis conditions.
A lack of statistically significant improvement, or equal or better performance by the rapid-quench control, would falsify the hypothesis.

contradictions.description: The intervention permits either slower cooling or a separate pre-annealing step, whereas the conditions state that all variables except the synthesis cooling profile are held constant. A pre-annealing step changes temperature history and annealing duration in addition to cooling profile.
